outcome: left ventricular posterior wall in diastole (LVPWd)
cohort: The study included 412 newborn twins (16% monochorionic; 50% boys) and 1236 matched singletons from the general population.
finding: Newborn twins had an increased prevalence of non-severe structural heart disease and initial differences in several cardiac parameters compared to singletons, although most parameters did not persist after multifactorial adjustment, except for LVPWd.
cross-section timing: during the first month of life
